description:
• About our brand and products:

For over 30 years, Hampstead Tea has been a pioneer in the organic and ethical tea movement. Founded by Kiran Tawadey in 1989, we were among the first to bring Fairtrade-certified tea to the UK. Our range is sourced directly from regenerative jungles—primarily the renowned Makaibari Tea Estate in Darjeeling, the world’s first certified biodynamic tea garden. From award-winning English Breakfast to therapeutic herbal infusions, every product we create is 100% organic, hand-picked, and designed with "planet-first" purity in mind.


• What makes us different:

We don't just follow sustainability trends; we set the standard.

  • The Stitch Method: Unlike most brands that use plastic glues or PLA (bioplastics) to seal their tea bags, we use a mechanical fold secured with a simple organic cotton stitch. This ensures your brew is 100% microplastic-free.

  • Biodynamic (Demeter) Certified: We go beyond "organic." Our teas are grown using regenerative agriculture that heals the soil, increases biodiversity, and sequesters carbon.

  • True Home Compostability: Our tea bags, unbleached paper envelopes, and NatureFlex™ loose-leaf pouches are designed to return to the earth in your own garden compost within 90 days—no industrial facility required.


• How affiliates can earn:

We value the partners who help us grow the regenerative movement. By joining the Hampstead Tea affiliate program, you can earn:

  • Competitive Commission: Earn a percentage of every sale you refer through your unique link or code.

  • High Average Order Value: Our customers love to stock up on their favorites and try our curated selection packs.

  • Performance Tiers: We reward our most active partners with increased commission rates and exclusive bonuses.

  • Early Access: Be the first to try and review our new product launches and seasonal blends.



• How to promote us:

  • Educational Content: Use our "Truth About PLA" research to educate your followers on the importance of microplastic-free tea.

  • Creative Assets: Access high-quality lifestyle photography, banners, and "unboxing" videos that highlight our plastic-free packaging.

  • Authentic Reviews: Share your personal experience with our jewel-like herbal infusions or our rich, hand-picked Darjeeling.

  • Exclusive Offers: Provide your audience with unique discount codes for first-time buyers to help "close the deal."
